cim: Resources investors flee to cash as AI jitters slam mining stocks
cim_eredeti: Resources investors flee to cash as AI jitters slam mining stocks
szoveg_eredeti:
A sudden unwinding in the commodity market’s hottest trades has unleashed carnage across the Australian sharemarket’s small-capitalisation mining sector, leaving the country’s top resources funds nursing heavy losses and forcing some to flee to the safety of cash.

The damage has been particularly severe for miners of copper, uranium and critical minerals such as rare earths, whose shares had surged because of their perceived exposure to the artificial intelligence boom.
